title: Glowing violin
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe9a8' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffe9a8' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='55' rx='44' ry='44' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='45' y='12' width='7' height='26' rx='2' fill='#c98a3c'/>
  <rect x='46.5' y='12' width='2.5' height='26' fill='#f2c078'/>
  <!-- scroll -->
  <path d='M45 12 q0 -7 5 -7 q5 0 5 6 q0 4 -4 4' fill='none' stroke='#f2c078' stroke-width='2.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- pegbox pegs -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='16' r='1.8' fill='#e0a94f'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='20' r='1.8' fill='#e0a94f'/>
  <!-- upper bout -->
  <path d='M32 38 q-9 4 -9 14 q0 10 9 13 q4 1.5 8 1 l14 0 q4 0.5 8 -1 q9 -3 9 -13 q0 -10 -9 -14 q-7 -3 -15 -3 q-8 0 -15 3 z' fill='#b06a24'/>
  <!-- lower bout -->
  <path d='M23 56 q-3 8 1 16 q4 9 13 11 q7 1.5 14 1.5 q7 0 14 -1.5 q9 -2 13 -11 q4 -8 1 -16 q-3 5 -9 6 q-9 1.5 -19 1.5 q-10 0 -19 -1.5 q-6 -1 -9 -6 z' fill='#c47a2c'/>
  <!-- waist highlight -->
  <path d='M31 55 q17 4 34 0' fill='none' stroke='#e8a150' stroke-width='1.4' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- f holes -->
  <path d='M38 48 q-3 4 0 9 q2 3 -1 6' fill='none' stroke='#7a3f10' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M58 48 q3 4 0 9 q-2 3 1 6' fill='none' stroke='#7a3f10' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- bridge -->
  <rect x='41' y='63' width='14' height='2.6' rx='1' fill='#f7d9a0'/>
  <!-- tailpiece -->
  <path d='M45 68 l5 16 l5 -16 z' fill='#5a2c0a'/>
  <!-- chinrest -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='78' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#3a1a04'/>
  <!-- strings -->
  <line x1='47' y1='16' x2='47.5' y2='64' stroke='#fff3c8' stroke-width='0.9'/>
  <line x1='48.6' y1='16' x2='49' y2='64' stroke='#fff3c8' stroke-width='0.9'/>
  <line x1='50.2' y1='16' x2='50.6' y2='64' stroke='#fff3c8' stroke-width='0.9'/>
  <line x1='51.8' y1='16' x2='52.2' y2='64' stroke='#fff3c8' stroke-width='0.9'/>
  <!-- bow -->
  <line x1='18' y1='44' x2='78' y2='72' stroke='#f0c070' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='18' y1='44' x2='78' y2='72' stroke='#fdffb0' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='44' r='2.4' fill='#e8a150'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='72' r='2.4' fill='#e8a150'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <path d='M74 22 l1.6 4 l4 1.6 l-4 1.6 l-1.6 4 l-1.6 -4 l-4 -1.6 l4 -1.6 z' fill='#fff6c0'/>
  <path d='M20 30 l1.2 3 l3 1.2 l-3 1.2 l-1.2 3 l-1.2 -3 l-3 -1.2 l3 -1.2 z' fill='#ffe9a0'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='88' r='1.8' fill='#fff6c0'/>
</svg>
